title: Awaken-HI: Scaling Humanoid Intelligence with Whole-Body Human Experience
summary: A central goal of humanoid robotics is for robots to perform the everyday work people do in homes and workplaces. Existing egocentric video datasets cover many of these activities but provide little synchronized whole-body motion data for learning loco-manipulation at scale. We build Awaken-Human, which pairs approximately 50,000 hours of egocentric stereo video with synchronized whole-body human motion and covers more than 100 skills. Building on this, we also introduce Awaken-HI (Humanoid Intelligence), a vision-language-action model for humanoid loco-manipulation that jointly predicts original human motion and retargeted robot actions through a shared action expert. We show that loco-manipulation skills transfer more effectively from people to humanoids when human trajectories directly supervise the shared action expert. Increasing human pretraining data reduces held-out robot action prediction error according to an empirical scaling law and raises the mean success rate on downstream real-robot tasks. After full-corpus pretraining and T800 adaptation, Awaken-HI achieves a mean success rate of 93.75% across eight individual tasks and outperforms GR00T N1.7 and $\pi_{0.5}$ in both individual and long-horizon evaluations. The same policy generalizes to objects unseen during robot post-training and to new pairings of familiar objects and destinations.

summary_zh: 人形机器人技术的一个核心目标是让机器人能够完成人们在家庭和工作场所中从事的日常工作。现有的第一人称（egocentric）视频数据集覆盖了其中许多活动，但很少提供同步的全身运动数据，难以用于大规模学习移动操作（loco-manipulation）。我们构建了 Awaken-Human，它将约 50,000 小时的第一人称立体视频与同步的全身人体运动配对，并覆盖超过 100 种技能。在此基础上，我们还提出了 Awaken-HI（Humanoid Intelligence，人形智能），这是一个用于人形机器人移动操作的视觉-语言-动作模型，通过一个共享的动作专家（shared action expert）联合预测原始人体运动和重定向后的机器人动作。我们表明，当人体轨迹直接监督该共享动作专家时，移动操作技能能够更有效地从人类迁移到人形机器人。根据一条经验缩放定律，增加人类预训练数据能够降低留出（held-out）机器人动作预测误差，并提高下游真实机器人任务的平均成功率。在经过全语料库预训练和 T800 适配之后，Awaken-HI 在八项单独任务上取得了 93.75% 的平均成功率，并在单独任务和长时程（long-horizon）评估中均优于 GR00T N1.7 和 $\pi_{0.5}$。同一策略能够泛化到机器人后训练阶段未见过的物体，以及熟悉物体与目标位置的新配对。

title: Omni-modal decomposition autoencoders learn full-stack wearable disentangled representations
summary: Learning disentangled representations is key for general-purpose multi-modal wearable models, yet existing approaches rarely combine classification, disentanglement, fusion, and generation of heterogeneous multi-modal time series in a single model. We introduce Omni-modal Variational Decomposition Autoencoders (OmniDecVAEs), a framework that learns multi-purpose representations from arbitrarily many modalities with a single shared encoder-decoder. OmniDecVAEs extend DecVAEs by learning time-frequency latent subspaces per modality through a multi-view self-supervised decomposition loss and a component-wise conditional decoder. On the omni-modal human activity recognition (HAR) HARWE dataset (up to thirty channels) and the public UCI HAR and WESAD datasets, OmniDecVAEs learn the most disentangled representations for unseen subjects (DCI disentanglement up to 3.0 percentage points (pp) higher). On HARWE, they improve subject-dependent HAR and identity recognition by 1.1 pp and 5.8 pp, and outperform supervised end-to-end models by +31.6 pp and +22.3 pp on unseen subjects of multi-device datasets. Moreover, their generative capacity improves reconstruction mean squared error over multi-modal VAEs (34-74% improvement) and their synthetic data improve affect recognition on unseen subjects (2 pp). With 4.1M parameters, invariant to the number of modalities (21xfewer than a multi-branch VAE), OmniDecVAEs are scalable, single-model full-stack learners for wearable representations.

summary_zh: 学习解耦表示是通用型多模态可穿戴模型的关键，然而现有方法很少在单一模型中同时结合异构多模态时间序列的分类、解耦、融合与生成。我们提出全模态变分分解自编码器（OmniDecVAEs），这是一个通过单一共享编码器-解码器从任意多个模态中学习多用途表示的框架。OmniDecVAEs 扩展了 DecVAEs，通过多视图自监督分解损失和逐分量条件解码器，为每个模态学习时频潜在子空间。在全模态人类活动识别（HAR）HARWE 数据集（多达三十个通道）以及公开的 UCI HAR 和 WESAD 数据集上，OmniDecVAEs 为未见受试者学习到了最解耦的表示（DCI 解耦度最高高出 3.0 个百分点（pp））。在 HARWE 上，它们将受试者相关的 HAR 和身份识别分别提升了 1.1 pp 和 5.8 pp，并且在多设备数据集的未见受试者上，比有监督的端到端模型分别高出 +31.6 pp 和 +22.3 pp。此外，它们的生成能力相比多模态 VAE 改善了重建均方误差（提升 34–74%），并且其合成数据改善了未见受试者的情感识别（2 pp）。OmniDecVAEs 仅具有 4.1M 参数，且对模态数量不变（比多分支 VAE 少 21 倍），是可扩展的、单模型的全栈可穿戴表示学习器。

title: CoRelate: Coordinated Human-Object Motion Synthesis through Interaction Relations
summary: Human-object motion synthesis requires coordinated human participation as objects move toward specified goals. However, reaching object targets does not ensure that contact is established and maintained, while adjustments that improve contact may interfere with task completion. We introduce CoRelate, a diffusion framework that coordinates full-body human-object motion through explicit interaction relations and task feedback for rigid and articulated objects. We represent intended participation through hand-part relations that specify the participating hand, its part-relative reference position, and participation interval. These relations serve both as generation conditions and as references for measuring interaction realization. At each denoising step, a temporal refiner trained jointly with the generator combines relation deviations, task residuals, and motion features from the current prediction to jointly update human and object motion across the sequence. After generation, temporal motion correction addresses remaining contact failures by optimizing local motion segments while preserving object trajectories and protected human motion. Experiments demonstrate improved object-goal satisfaction, contact F1, and complete interaction success over the evaluated baselines. Ablation studies support the benefits of relation conditioning and the complementary roles of task and relation feedback.

AI.conclusion: CoRelate 通过显式交互关系与任务反馈有效协调人-物运动，在刚体与铰接物体上均取得更优的目标达成与接触维持表现，证明了关系条件化及任务/关系反馈互补设计的有效性。

summary_zh: 人-物运动合成需要协调的人体参与，因为物体会朝着指定目标移动。然而，到达物体目标并不能确保接触得以建立和维持，而改善接触的调整又可能干扰任务完成。我们提出 CoRelate，这是一个扩散框架，通过显式的交互关系和任务反馈来协调全身人-物运动，适用于刚性和铰接物体。我们通过手-部件关系来表示预期的参与，这些关系指定了参与的手、其相对于部件的参考位置以及参与区间。这些关系既作为生成条件，也作为衡量交互实现程度的参考。在每个去噪步骤中，一个与生成器联合训练的时间细化器结合来自当前预测的关系偏差、任务残差和运动特征，在整个序列上联合更新人体和物体运动。生成之后，时间运动校正通过优化局部运动片段来解决剩余的接触失败问题，同时保留物体轨迹和受保护的人体运动。实验表明，与所评估的基线相比，物体目标满足度、接触 F1 和完整交互成功率均有所提升。消融研究支持了关系条件化的益处，以及任务反馈和关系反馈的互补作用。

title: MV-JEPA: Post-Training Video Encoders for Cross-View Understanding
summary: JEPA-based video encoders learn strong representations for video and image understanding through prediction in latent space. However, their standard pretraining predicts features within individual images or video clips, without explicitly exploiting paired camera views of the same object or moment. Consequently, the learned representations may not reliably support matching across different camera viewpoints. To solve this problem, we introduce multi-view predictive post-training to strengthen cross-view instance and temporal correspondence while retaining independent single-view inference. A shared encoder processes masked context views independently, and a training-time predictor jointly predicts latent tokens for masked context regions and a fully held-out view. We alternate cross-view prediction with single-view masked prediction on general image and video data to help retain the encoder's pretrained capabilities. After only 9,000 post-training updates on a single GPU, MV-JEPA improves cross-view instance retrieval and coarse cross-camera moment retrieval on various datasets, with further gains in zero-shot action-phase retrieval and frozen-feature classification on AE2. Frozen-probe evaluations further indicate that post-training largely preserves motion recognition, image recognition, and dense semantic segmentation performance on the evaluated benchmarks. Together, these results demonstrate that multi-view predictive post-training can strengthen instance and coarse temporal correspondence in JEPA video encoders without modifying the encoder architecture or single-view inference interface.

AI.motivation: JEPA 视频编码器通过潜在空间预测学习强表征，但标准预训练只在单张图像或单个视频片段内预测特征，未显式利用同一物体/时刻的配对相机视角，导致学习到的表征难以可靠支持跨相机视角匹配。
AI.method: 提出多视角预测后训练（MV-JEPA）：共享编码器独立处理掩码上下文视角，训练期预测器联合预测掩码上下文区域的潜在 token 以及一个完全保留（held-out）的视角；并将跨视角预测与通用图像/视频数据上的单视角掩码预测交替进行，以保留编码器原有预训练能力。
AI.result: 仅用单 GPU 进行 9,000 次后训练更新后，MV-JEPA 在多个数据集上提升了跨视角实例检索和粗粒度跨相机时刻检索，并在 AE2 上进一步提升了零样本动作阶段检索和冻结特征分类性能；冻结探针评估表明后训练基本保留了运动识别、图像识别和稠密语义分割性能。
AI.conclusion: 多视角预测后训练能够在不修改编码器架构或单视角推理接口的情况下，增强 JEPA 视频编码器的实例与粗粒度时间对应能力，同时保持原有单视角任务性能。

summary_zh: 基于JEPA的视频编码器通过在潜在空间中进行预测，学习到用于视频和图像理解的强表征。然而，其标准预训练是在单个图像或视频片段内部预测特征，并未显式利用同一物体或同一时刻的成对相机视角。因此，学习到的表征可能无法可靠地支持跨不同相机视点的匹配。为解决这一问题，我们引入多视角预测式后训练，以增强跨视角实例对应和时间对应，同时保留独立的单视角推理能力。一个共享编码器独立处理被掩蔽的上下文视角，训练时的预测器联合预测被掩蔽上下文区域以及一个完全保留（held-out）视角的潜在token。我们在通用图像和视频数据上交替进行跨视角预测与单视角掩蔽预测，以帮助保留编码器预训练所获得的能力。仅在单个GPU上进行9,000次后训练更新后，MV-JEPA在多个数据集上提升了跨视角实例检索和粗粒度跨相机时刻检索的性能，并在AE2上的零样本动作阶段检索和冻结特征分类方面取得了进一步增益。冻结探针评估进一步表明，后训练在很大程度上保留了在所评估基准上的运动识别、图像识别和稠密语义分割性能。综合而言，这些结果表明，多视角预测式后训练能够在不修改编码器架构或单视角推理接口的情况下，增强JEPA视频编码器中的实例对应和粗粒度时间对应。

title: Persistent Identity in Person Tracking: Online Enrollment and Registered Recognition
summary: We extend PoseTReID with online appearance-bank matching (Gallery) and a residual-conflict guard for registered SVM recognition. All methods use supplied ground-truth (GT) person boxes. We average all-box assessment IDF1/HOTA equally across videos. On six SportsMOT clips, StrongSORT leads standalone trackers (79.44/84.72%) and exceeds both Gallery variants. Over eleven videos, Gallery AIN (83.29/85.44%) and COPE (84.66/86.38%) exceed standalone trackers with complete results. This lead depends on two retrospectively added GTA development compilations and is absent on the original nine videos. Registered SVMs lead both cohorts among complete results, with AIN at 95.72/94.82% over eleven videos. They use every GT crop from approximately 20% of frames, including future appearances. On MOT20-03, registered AIN reached 96.80% IDF1 and assigned the correct enrolled name to 90.72% of assessment GT observations. Gallery and standalone trackers receive no per-video labelled enrollment. Both identity routes restore identities across internal title cards, but Gallery trails SORT on three videos (four in HOTA) and both SVMs trail SORT on MOT16-04/MOT20-03. Under six-clip persistent-only scoring, native Gallery gains 2.39 percentage points in mean IDF1 over a matched control, with lower correct-P coverage and 5.02 times as many encoder attempts. Pose gating is mixed; the guard's metric effect is not isolated.
comment: 7 pages, 2 figures, 7 tables. An earlier version of this paper was submitted to an IEEE conference

AI.result: 在六段 SportsMOT 片段上，StrongSORT 领先独立跟踪器（79.44/84.72%）并超过两种 Gallery 变体；在十一段视频上，Gallery AIN（83.29/85.44%）与 COPE（84.66/86.38%）超过独立跟踪器，但该优势依赖两个事后加入的 GTA 开发编译，在原始九段视频上不存在。注册 SVM 在两个队列的完整结果中均领先，AIN 在十一段视频上达 95.72/94.82%，其使用约 20% 帧的全部 GT 裁剪（含未来出现）。在 MOT20-03 上，注册 AIN 达 96.80% IDF1，并为 90.72% 的评估 GT 观测分配了正确注册名。Gallery 与独立跟踪器未获得逐视频标注注册。两条身份路径都能跨内部标题卡恢复身份，但 Gallery 在三个视频（HOTA 为四个）落后于 SORT，两个 SVM 在 MOT16-04/MOT20-03 落后于 SORT。六片段 persistent-only 评分下，原生 Gallery 的平均 IDF1 比匹配对照高 2.39 个百分点，但正确 P 覆盖率更低、编码器尝试次数为 5.02 倍。姿态门控效果不一，守卫的指标影响未被单独隔离。
AI.conclusion: 注册 SVM 在完整结果中表现最强，但其优势依赖使用大量 GT 裁剪（含未来帧）且部分优势来自事后加入的开发编译；Gallery 与独立跟踪器在无逐视频注册条件下表现较弱，且 Gallery 的优势在原始视频上不成立。姿态门控与守卫的作用尚需进一步隔离验证。

summary_zh: 我们通过在线外观库匹配（Gallery）以及用于已注册SVM识别的残差冲突防护，对PoseTReID进行了扩展。所有方法均使用所提供的真实标注（GT）人物框。我们在各视频上对全框评估指标IDF1/HOTA进行等权平均。在六个SportsMOT片段上，StrongSORT在独立跟踪器中领先（79.44/84.72%），并超过两种Gallery变体。在十一个视频上，Gallery AIN（83.29/85.44%）和COPE（84.66/86.38%）在具有完整结果的情况下超过独立跟踪器。这一领先依赖于两个事后添加的GTA开发编译集，而在最初的九个视频上并不存在。在具有完整结果的各队列中，已注册SVM均领先，AIN在十一个视频上达到95.72/94.82%。它们使用了约20%帧中的每一个GT裁剪，包括未来出现的情况。在MOT20-03上，已注册AIN达到96.80%的IDF1，并为90.72%的评估GT观测分配了正确的已注册姓名。Gallery和独立跟踪器未获得任何逐视频的带标签注册。两种身份路径都能在内部标题卡之间恢复身份，但Gallery在三个视频上落后于SORT（HOTA上为四个），且两种SVM在MOT16-04/MOT20-03上均落后于SORT。在六片段仅持久性评分下，原生Gallery的平均IDF1较匹配对照提高了2.39个百分点，但正确P覆盖率更低，且编码器尝试次数为5.02倍。姿态门控效果不一；该防护的度量效应未被单独分离。

title: MoGloss: Joint Motion and Pseudo-Gloss Pretraining for American Sign Language Understanding
summary: Sign language translation and recognition have been shown to benefit from various pretraining approaches. We propose a novel two-stage pretraining approach for the motion encoder, which first learns to reconstruct masked motion, followed by joint masked prediction of pseudo-gloss units and motion. Pseudo-glosses serve as an intermediate structured representation of natural language text and are obtained from the captions by a large language model. We curate a corpus of about 1,100 hours of American Sign Language from five public datasets, estimate 2D pose for all clips and define an evaluation protocol. We then reproduce state-of-the-art translation methods and evaluate them using the same train and test splits. We propose a translation model built on our pretraining strategy, and this model outperforms the previous state-of-the-art methods Uni-Sign and SHuBERT, as well as the YouTube-ASL baseline, on the How2Sign, ASL STEM Wiki and OpenASL datasets. Furthermore, the gain from the joint pretraining using motion and pseudo-gloss grows as translation data shrinks. A classifier built on the same encoder also achieves state-of-the-art accuracy on ASL Citizen isolated sign recognition and outperforms our reproduction of Uni-Sign on WLASL2000.

title: SkillLens: Action-Guided Dense Visual Dynamics for Proficiency Estimation
summary: Human proficiency estimation is challenging because skill is a high-level and often subjective property that is not captured by action identity alone. Existing approaches leverage multimodal observations such as ego-exo video, gaze, pose, and inertial signals, but the gap between sensor-level evidence and abstract proficiency labels remains difficult to bridge. We present SkillLens, a proficiency estimation framework that uses atomic action descriptions as temporal guidance, rather than direct semantic supervision, to localize proficiency-relevant windows for dense visual-dynamics extraction. Each window is summarized into an action-dynamics feature and scored by a high-low prototype margin against higher- and lower-proficiency executions from the same activity-action category. Fusing these ego/exo PDM cues with a global ego-exo-gaze baseline through CORAL ordinal calibration, our method achieves 0.542 accuracy on Ego-Exo4D. Our project page is available at https://skill-lens.net/

title: Fast and Accurate Body Estimation in Pixels, World Space and Scenes
summary: We present FAB (Fast and Accurate Body estimation), a human body estimator that jointly improves inference efficiency and body-recovery fidelity. Rather than predicting only parametric mesh-model parameters, FAB directly predicts human skeleton joints and dense surface points. In images, it predicts dense 2D and 3D body points alongside a parametric Momentum Human Rig (MHR) head, then fits SMPL in one learned pass followed by two Gauss-Newton steps. Its ViT-L student, FAB-L, distilled from a fine-tuned SAM 3D Body, runs in real time for one person on an RTX 4070 Ti SUPER, from detection to a fitted body, at 4.6x the speed of SAM 3D Body's eager-PyTorch body-only path, while improving accuracy on most camera-space benchmarks. The same network predicts heel, toe, hand, and knee contacts, which connect the body to the scene. FAB also estimates world-space motion, fuses static-scene depth around the visible person, and aligns body and scene using predicted contacts. For human-to-humanoid real-to-sim transfer, an in-model G1 head and FAB-Retarget, a motion-level retargeter that reads dense points or the fitted mesh, map motion to a Unitree G1. FAB-Retarget produces references that follow the person more closely than specialized retargeters including SOMA, GMR, UMR, and OmniRetarget, and substantially more closely than Fast SAM 3D Body retargeted with our sequence IK. Project page: https://www.jinkuncao.com/FAB.

title: StreamEgo: Streaming Exocentric-to-Egocentric Video Generation
summary: Exocentric-to-egocentric (Exo2Ego) video generation transforms third-person recordings into first-person viewpoints, unlocking immersive AR/VR experiences and scalable demonstration synthesis for embodied robotics. Extending it to a streaming setting is expected to further enable live applications. However, existing methods suffer from degraded manipulation regions, overfitting and confinement to fixed-length clips with prohibitive latency. To address these limitations, we present StreamEgo, a real-time framework for unbounded, generalizable Exo2Ego video generation. To resolve intricate manipulation dynamics while supporting the streaming pipeline, a streaming dual-branch prior provides pixel-aligned guidance for translating appearance and skeletal kinematics. We also introduce a region-aware loss curriculum to improve generalization and stabilize multi-objective diffusion training. Furthermore, we distill the model into a chunk-wise autoregressive model, augmented with a region-aware corruption mechanism and a first-chunk curriculum, enabling high-quality, generalizable real-time streaming Exo2Ego generation at 24.3 FPS on a single H100 GPU.

title: Inhabitant: An Agent Framework for Long-Horizon Human-Scene Interaction with Spatial Control and Quantitative Feedback
summary: Recent work on human-scene interaction (HSI) generation moves from single interactions to long-horizon interaction, where a language-model agent plans and executes a sequence of interactions in a 3D scene under one instruction. However, existing agents struggle in challenging everyday scenarios (e.g., picking up a toy and throwing it into a basket) because they lack spatial control over the motion and quantitative feedback on its execution, and they often fail to complete the interaction sequence. To address these gaps, we present Inhabitant, a training-free agent framework in which the agent specifies each motion through positions, paths and poses, measures how the executed interaction deviates from its intent, and revises the control specification accordingly. For an extensive evaluation in such scenarios, we build Inhabit, a benchmark of 75 household tasks in 31 furniture layouts of an apartment, in which every task chains one to three goals on movable objects and is carried out by the whole body, excluding fingers. On Inhabit, Inhabitant completes 98.7\% of the tasks with Claude Opus 5.5, and 93.3\% and 82.7\% with Claude Sonnet 5.5 and Gemini 4 Argon, respectively. Ablations confirm that without spatial control the agent fails most tasks, and without quantitative feedback its motion becomes less precise. Code is available on the project page.

summary_zh: 近期关于人-场景交互（HSI）生成的研究正从单一交互转向长时程交互，即由语言模型智能体在一条指令下，于三维场景中规划并执行一系列交互。然而，现有智能体在具有挑战性的日常场景（例如，捡起一个玩具并将其扔进篮子里）中表现不佳，因为它们缺乏对运动的空间控制以及对其执行的定量反馈，并且常常无法完成整个交互序列。为弥补这些不足，我们提出了 Inhabitant，一个无需训练的智能体框架，在该框架中，智能体通过位置、路径和姿态来指定每个运动，衡量所执行交互与其意图之间的偏差，并据此修正控制规格。为了在此类场景中进行广泛评估，我们构建了 Inhabit，这是一个包含 75 项家务任务的基准，涵盖一套公寓的 31 种家具布局，其中每项任务将一到三个针对可移动物体的目标串联起来，并由除手指外的全身执行。在 Inhabit 上，Inhabitant 使用 Claude Opus 5.5 完成了 98.7\% 的任务，使用 Claude Sonnet 5.5 和 Gemini 4 Argon 分别完成了 93.3\% 和 82.7\% 的任务。消融实验证实，若没有空间控制，智能体在大多数任务中都会失败；若没有定量反馈，其运动会变得不够精确。代码可在项目页面上获取。

title: Parameter-Efficient Adaptation of Self-supervised Vision Backbones Survives Distribution Shift in Radar Micro-Doppler HAR
summary: Micro-Doppler radar enables contactless, privacy-preserving human activity recognition (HAR), but deployment robustness remains underexplored. We compared full fine-tuning, frozen probing, and parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) using subject-disjoint in-distribution cross-validation and few-shot cross-age, cross-orientation, and cross-dataset transfer. Full fine-tuning suffered negative cross-dataset transfer, while frozen features under-adapted on cross-orientation. Only PEFT avoided both failures. We paired DINOv3 with all-layer principal-singular-direction adaptation (PiSSA), to our knowledge the first application of a self-supervised image foundation backbone to radar micro-Doppler HAR. DINOv3-PiSSA ranked first among PEFT methods in every evaluated setting. Under our protocol, its Small variant matched the in-distribution accuracy of the prior Base-size PEFT state of the art using 4.5x fewer total parameters, with only 3% trainable. It surpassed a size-matched variant of that baseline in every evaluated setting, with transfer gains increasing with shift severity: 2.1, 6.6, and 8.9 percentage points, respectively. Ablations attributed improvements to both pretraining and adapter recipe, with the pretraining contributing most under compound shift. Code and protocol are available at https://github.com/KeryanChelouche/udoppler-ssl.

title: Bio-PM-Guided Synthetic IMU Generation
summary: Collecting and labeling inertial measurement unit (IMU) data for human activity recognition (HAR) is expensive, and models trained on one group of subjects often fail to generalize to unseen individuals. Even with balanced data, classifiers struggle to distinguish dynamically similar activity classes and benefit from targeted augmentation. We explore whether synthetic IMU data generated in the representation space of a pretrained biosignal encoder, Bio-PM \cite{b1}, can serve as a practical augmentation source. Rather than synthesizing raw signals, we leverage Bio-PM's frozen encoder to convert 10-second IMU windows into token embedding sequences and train class-conditional decoders in this space: (1) an autoregressive transformer decoder that predicts tokens sequentially, and (2) a diffusion decoder that learns the token distribution through a denoising objective. We analyze generation realism through distributional metrics and embedding-space visualizations, evaluate downstream utility through leave-one-subject-out HAR classification, and present a PatchDecoder for approximate raw waveform reconstruction. Our diffusion decoder achieves a Train-on-Synthetic-Test-on-Real (TSTR) macro-F1 of 0.68, demonstrating that generated tokens are realistic enough to train a classifier that transfers to real data. Combining synthetic-token augmentation with a 320-dimensional gravity-aware feature representation raises LOSO macro-F1 from 0.729 to 0.809 over a real-only baseline across 51 subjects on the WISDM benchmark, with statistically significant gains concentrated in the most challenging activity classes. These results demonstrate that high-fidelity generation in a pretrained encoder's representation space is achievable and practically useful for cross-subject HAR augmentation.

AI.conclusion: 在预训练编码器表示空间中进行高保真生成是可行且实用的，能够有效用于跨受试者 HAR 的数据增强，显著提升对困难活动类别的分类性能。

summary_zh: 为人类活动识别（HAR）采集和标注惯性测量单元（IMU）数据成本高昂，且在一组受试者上训练的模型往往无法泛化到未见过的个体。即使数据均衡，分类器也难以区分动态相似的活动类别，并能从有针对性的增强中获益。我们探索了在预训练生物信号编码器 Bio-PM \cite{b1} 的表示空间中生成的合成 IMU 数据能否作为一种实用的增强来源。我们并非合成原始信号，而是利用 Bio-PM 的冻结编码器将 10 秒的 IMU 窗口转换为 token 嵌入序列，并在该空间中训练类别条件解码器：（1）一个自回归 transformer 解码器，按顺序预测 token；（2）一个扩散解码器，通过去噪目标学习 token 分布。我们通过分布度量和嵌入空间可视化分析生成的逼真度，通过留一受试者交叉验证（LOSO）的 HAR 分类评估下游效用，并提出一种用于近似原始波形重建的 PatchDecoder。我们的扩散解码器在合成数据训练、真实数据测试（TSTR）上取得了 0.68 的宏 F1 值，表明生成的 token 足够逼真，能够训练出可迁移到真实数据的分类器。将合成 token 增强与 320 维重力感知特征表示相结合，在 WISDM 基准的 51 名受试者上，相比仅使用真实数据的基线，将 LOSO 宏 F1 从 0.729 提升至 0.809，且统计上显著的增益集中在最具挑战性的活动类别中。这些结果表明，在预训练编码器的表示空间中实现高保真生成是可行的，并且对跨受试者 HAR 增强具有实际用途。
